scope: R06 engineering preparation and exact pinned primary-source review; partial component ledger, not clearance or a full SBOM
custody_note: Historical archive identities remain fixed. R04 retrieval/rebuild proceeds separately; this ledger does not attest to retrieval or a new native output.

components.role: build-only tools; source included in retained build instructions
components.terms_observed: Original helpers use MIT. Running GCC, CMake, Git, Python or Docker does not make their complete source part of the emulator; runtime/header material incorporated by compilation needs its own row.
remaining_evidence: Retain helper revision, actual package/source versions and generated commands with each recovered or rebuilt candidate.

components.terms_observed: GPL-2.0-or-later for the engine/project modification scope; LICENSE.TXT also carries a PSPSDK BSD notice. Linked components and adjacent assets retain separate terms.
remaining_evidence: R04 exact binary/source/build archive retrieval or new paired rebuild record.
Review GPL version selection and compatible terms for the actual combination; preserve notices, modification information and corresponding source.

components.role: build scripts plus source text inserted into compiled engine
components.terms_observed: The untruncated pinned tree contains no licence-named files. The reviewed README, Dockerfile.pvr, build-pvr.sh and ten selected source-edit scripts provide no explicit grant. The generated source changes need scope review even when scripts execute only during a build.
remaining_evidence: Identify applicable grant for exact scripts and generated modifications.
Keep ten selected scripts and resulting source postimages paired with the engine.

generated_configuration.scope: Observed configure result only; each selected source/dependency retains its own notices and obligations

components.terms_observed: Pinned LICENSE.md identifies LGPL-2.1-or-later by default and other per-file terms. Historical generated configuration states LGPL version 2.1 or later, CONFIG_GPL=0, CONFIG_NONFREE=0, CONFIG_VERSION3=0. This statement applies to that configuration and the five recorded archives.
remaining_evidence: Retrieve/rebuild exact FFmpeg sources, headers, five archives, generated configuration and build commands.
Review source/relink or other applicable GPL/LGPL distribution route for the actual combined executable.
Record per-file exceptions such as IJG credit; filename inventory alone does not resolve them.

components.role: component notices inside enabled codec source
components.terms_observed: Pinned LICENSE.md calls for IJG credit in executable-only documentation and change disclosure for three named sources. The inspected jfdctfst.c header gives the required wording. Configure selects IDCTDSP for MJPEG decoding; Makefile includes jrevdct.o under IDCTDSP and jfdctfst.o/jfdctint.o under FDCTDSP.
remaining_evidence: Map actual enabled configuration, object/archive members and retained final link to incorporated JPEG code.
Retain the applicable IJG notice and change record with the exact source/build package and future executable documentation.

components.terms_observed: Upstream GCC 9.4.0 COPYING.RUNTIME states GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1 under GPLv3 section 7. The inspected eh_alloc.cc carries GPL-3.0-or-later plus that exception. The exception applies to covered files and eligible compilation processes; it does not grant the independent modules broader rights.
remaining_evidence: Recover exact Ubuntu cross-package copyright/source notices and archive provenance for 9.4.0-1ubuntu1~20.04.2cross2, including Ubuntu changes.
Map incorporated runtime/header code and confirm applicable exception/compilation scope.
Retain necessary GPL/runtime exception texts; do not classify the static archive as a build-only compiler.

components.role: third-party shader code linked by pinned source build
components.terms_observed: glslang LICENSE.txt contains multiple BSD and other component notices; SPIRV-Cross LICENSE gives Apache-2.0. Pinned PPSSPP CMakeLists.txt adds glslang/SPIRV/spirv-cross-glsl targets. Recover final build records to bind that source selection to each executable.
remaining_evidence: Retain full relevant glslang component notices and SPIRV-Cross licence/NOTICE where applicable.
Review actual GPL version/combination obligations; do not label the whole dependency set GPL-2.0-only.

components.role: third-party compression/disc code selected by source build
components.terms_observed: The checked Zstandard and libchdr licence texts impose BSD source/binary notice conditions. libchdr includes nested LZMA, zlib and zstd material with separate notices. Pinned PPSSPP CMakeLists.txt selects chdr and a static zstd target.
remaining_evidence: Map incorporated members and retain nested component notices in matching source and binary documentation.

components.terms_observed: libpng17 png.h contains its licence, including origin/change/source-notice restrictions. xbrz.h carries a GPL notice and a MAME linking exception. The historical list of 55 notice filenames omits these source headers.
remaining_evidence: Review compiled per-file licence/version scope and preserve inline notices with corresponding source.
Inspect the rest of ext/ and generated sources from actual compile/link records, including header-only code.

components.terms_observed: Pinned CMake source names these targets. Final object/source membership and per-file terms need the recovered/rebuilt compile/link record. A 55-file notice list includes UI implementation files, test-only sources and empty nested build/LICENSE files; its count is not a reviewed component count.
remaining_evidence: Create exact compiled-source/static-archive member map; classify disabled/test/host-only code separately.
Review applicable file terms and required credits; preserve complete submodule revisions and notices.

project_patch.modifications_license: GPL-3.0-or-later; external recipe/source grants remain separately audited

components.terms_observed: Retained RetroArch and project modification scope is GPL-3.0-or-later. The upstream COPYING file contains GPLv3; component file headers retain their own notices.
remaining_evidence: R04 exact binary, complete original/patched source and build-record retrieval or new paired rebuild.
Map compiled third-party code, assets and required notices from generated configuration and link trace.

components.role: compiled IGM/shared source and build scripts
components.terms_observed: The untruncated pinned tree contains no licence-named files. Reviewed README, Dockerfile, build.sh, four common patches and three shared IGM sources contain no explicit licence grant. Project GPL modification notices do not resolve the external shared-code/recipe scope.
remaining_evidence: Identify applicable terms/grant for selected common IGM code, patches and recipe.
Retain exact source preimages/postimages with each binary; do not replace missing external grant with root project MIT or engine GPL labels.

components.terms_observed: The historical recipe builds static audio/video filters, and the build records report bundled SPIR-V/glslang ODR warnings. Disabling Vulkan for TG5040 does not establish that shader/compiler code disappears from this linked binary. The generated configuration and archive/link members define scope.
remaining_evidence: Recover config.h/config.mk and final compile/link records; inventory incorporated filter, TLS, compression, shader and other component sources.
Review per-file terms and notices from the exact engine tree; do not infer scope from one disabled driver flag.

components.role: build input container; dynamic dependencies and possible incorporated headers/startup code
components.terms_observed: Pinned PPSSPP recipe README calls the PVR/TSPS SDKs proprietary. Release body says vendor SDK tarballs for per-device PPSSPP builds and supplies no additional terms. The Linaro archive supplies sysroot, not the compiler selected for historical builds. Each library/header/startup object needs its own scope.
remaining_evidence: Inventory actual archives for per-component notices and exact SDK/PVR grants.
Separate build-only files, code incorporated into executable, libraries proposed for bundling, and dependencies expected on the device.
Review applicable linkage/system-library scope; an SDK hash, download permission or ABI audit does not establish redistribution permission.

components.role: ELF dependencies expected on target; none selected for public bundling
components.terms_observed: Historical readelf audits resolve dependency basenames/symbol versions against the SDK inventory. These reports identify dependency names only; they do not identify the actual installed loader choices or establish whether any library can be bundled.
remaining_evidence: After D02, D03 captures actual installed hashes, paths, mapped libraries, drivers and notices.
If a future package bundles any dynamic library, give that exact byte set a separate source/notice/permission review and retained artifact entry.

components.terms_observed: Pinned recipe copies the whole assets directory beside PPSSPP. Font/UI/shader/data terms need a separate inventory. The frontend original-only preview uses its own MIT graphics and retained Noto OFL font; that scope does not license native assets.
remaining_evidence: Recover or rebuild complete native asset manifests and per-file terms, including recursive debugger gitlink.
Select only justified assets; retain attribution/licences and exclude owner game data, Sony references and unrelated SDK files.

fresh_primary_source_review.method: GitHub connected read-only fetches of exact pinned recipe trees/files and component terms; SHA-256 of returned UTF-8 bytes compared to checked-in recipe locks. Two FFmpeg dependency files also matched their Git blob IDs in the new pristine pinned recursive gitlink checkout.

source_files.verification: GitHub connected fetch and whole-file byte recheck in exact pinned recursive gitlink source
GitHub connected fetch and whole-file byte recheck in exact pinned recursive gitlink source

limits: No licence-named file in a tree does not prove absence of a grant elsewhere. The reviewed files identify unresolved exact scope.
Excerpt digests are SHA-256 of returned lines only; git_blob_sha identifies the complete upstream file.
GCC upstream terms reference is not proof of exact Ubuntu cross-package source correspondence.
A licence text/source build success is not combined-distribution clearance.

Review exact external recipe/IGM/SDK grants and source/notices for incorporated components.
Confirm configured component membership and distribution method, including FFmpeg and GCC runtime scope.
Actual R05 notice delivery/scope evidence remains separate from commercial permission; no send instruction exists.
